title: How Much of Your Netflix Bill Is Profit?
description:

Sources:

scenes.narration: Out of every dollar you pay Netflix, how much does it keep as profit?
First, the scale. In 2025, more than 325 million paid memberships brought in 45 billion dollars.
Then Netflix pays for all those shows.
What's left? About 30 cents of operating profit on every dollar.
And the cheaper plan with ads is growing. Ad revenue hit 1.5 billion dollars in 2025.
Netflix expects that to roughly double again in 2026.
